name: Borra Caves Bamboo Chicken Stalls
area: Borra Caves entrance plaza, Ananthagiri Hills
signature_dish: Bamboo chicken — chicken roasted inside a green bamboo tube over a wood fire
why_it_matters: The cluster of tribal-run stalls right outside the Borra Caves gate is the signature eating experience here — chicken marinated in local spices, sealed inside fresh bamboo and slow-roasted over a wood fire with no oil. It is the same bamboo-chicken tradition as Araku, cooked at the cave-mouth where Adivasi families have always sold it.
insider_tip: Order on the way in, not the way out — the bamboo takes 30-45 minutes. Stalls sit at the start of the approach, so you can collect it after the cave visit. Tribal women near the parking also sell roasted corn and local root snacks.
signature_address: Borra Caves entrance plaza, Ananthagiri Mandal, Alluri Sitharama Raju District, Andhra Pradesh 531149

name: APTDC Haritha Restaurant, Borra Caves
area: Borra Caves main gate, Ananthagiri Hills
signature_dish: Government-run tourist canteen — South Indian meals and refreshments
why_it_matters: AP Tourism's Haritha restaurant sits just outside the Borra Caves main gate — the only proper sit-down option at the cave site itself, serving lunch and refreshments to tourists. For a clean plate and a seat after the cave descent, it is the practical choice over the open-air stalls.
insider_tip: The menu is limited and reviewers say the food is functional rather than memorable — treat it as a convenient stop, not a destination meal. Best for a quick veg thali and coffee before the drive on to Araku.
signature_address: APTDC Haritha Restaurant, Borra Caves main gate, Ananthagiri Mandal, Alluri Sitharama Raju District, Andhra Pradesh 531149

name: APTDC Ananthagiri Haritha Hill Resort Restaurant
area: Ananthagiri Hills, on the Vizag–Araku road
signature_dish: Hill-resort multi-cuisine meals amid the Ananthagiri coffee estates
why_it_matters: The restaurant at AP Tourism's Ananthagiri Haritha Hill Resort — set in the coffee-estate hills between Borra Caves and Araku, also handy for the Anantha Padmanabha Swamy temple. It is the closest full sit-down resort meal to Borra Caves once you leave the cave plaza, with fresh food and a bar.
insider_tip: Ananthagiri is roughly the midpoint of the Vizag–Araku ghat drive — a good lunch break with a coffee-estate setting. Non-residents can usually eat at the restaurant; call ahead in peak season.
signature_address: APTDC Ananthagiri Haritha Hill Resort, Ananthagiri, Vizag–Araku Road, Alluri Sitharama Raju District, Andhra Pradesh 531145
